title: EventEnvelope
description: One fact on the event bus. Telemetry, alerts, tickets, investigation steps, approvals, corrective actions, and commands share this envelope. The lifecycle documents in this folder stay a separate catalog.

eventId.description: Universally unique lexicographically sortable identifier assigned by the bus when the publisher leaves it empty.

type.description: Dotted name such as telemetry.reading, alert.raised, ticket.created, investigation.step, approval.granted, capa.created, or command.fault.inject.

correlationId.description: Shared by every event in one cascade, from the root command to the last corrective action.

causationId.description: The event that caused this one. A reading caused by a fault points at the fault command. An alert points at the triggering reading.

parentEventId.description: The event this one hangs from in the trace tree. Fan-out uses the same id as causation. A later step uses the previous step.

sequence.description: Monotonic per correlation id. The bus assigns it.

source.description: Who published the fact, such as injector, simulator, spc, intake, investigation, or presenter.

payload.description: Type-specific body. An empty object is allowed.
